membershipPolicy: Start-of-period membership frozen throughout the evaluation; later index changes do not alter eligibility.
shareClassPolicy: Security-level membership includes both GOOG and GOOGL; equal-weight controls weight securities rather than issuers.

excludedSecurities.reason: The 2026-06-29 Honeywell Aerospace distribution plus HON 1-for-2 reverse split is outside split/dividend-only accounting; no substitute is added.
Yahoo has no finite opening price for the 2026-07-20 exchange session; missing execution data is not imputed or forward-filled.

The 2026-01-05 Versant Media Group distribution (one Versant share per 25 Comcast shares) is outside split/dividend-only accounting; Yahoo's 1067:1000 factor on 2026-01-05 is a spin-off value ratio, not a share ratio; no substitute is added.
Yahoo has no history before the 2025-02-13 Sandisk/Western Digital separation, so the required 100-bar warmup for an April 2025 evaluation start cannot be satisfied without imputation.

The 2025-02-24 Sandisk distribution (one-third Sandisk share per Western Digital share, distributed February 21, 2025) is outside split/dividend-only accounting; Yahoo's 1.323 factor on 2025-02-24 is a spin-off value ratio, not a share ratio; no substitute is added.
